nurse.text: Welcome to the St Davids Sanctuary. The smallest city, the biggest sofa. Pop your team on the counter.
What can we do for you?

then.text: A quick rest, a warm cup of tea, and the Ark's pilgrims will be along shortly.
All better! Walk gently. Pilgrims have been coming this way for a thousand years.
The Ark terminal's just here. Mind the pew.

else.text: Right you are. Shout if anyone needs a plaster.
